manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0101; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: The learner turns ‘Yes, this is a special case.’ and ‘That is a different case.’ are short, plausible spoken English for the selected bounded sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps case to «مورد» in this Lesson context.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors are same-format alternatives and avoid random unrelated noise in the scored target choices.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner responses remain short and controlled for A1 while adding one small contextual shift.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner turn reuses the same lexical sense in a changed prompt rather than merely repeating the first sentence.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario, target construction, dialogue, and final retrieval all align to one bounded sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 target sense of case.
Generated audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
resolvedFindings: English turns were checked for contextual plausibility.
Persian wording was checked for meaning consistency and Persian orthography.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval rather than answer copying.
Story recurrence is spaced by 5 Lessons and the learner role/story beat is varied.
Quality v3: dialogue exposure, duplicate scoring, safe speech equivalence and grounded story copy rechecked after deterministic remediation.
